name: investigate-report
summary: For incidents and research. Investigators collect evidence in parallel, an analyst finds the cause, a writer writes the report, a reviewer checks each claim.

roles.name: investigator
roles.job: Reads one evidence source (for example one log file). Writes facts with timestamps. Use several investigators at the same time.

roles.name: analyst
roles.job: Joins the facts into one timeline. Tests each possible cause. Rejects causes that the evidence does not support.

roles.name: writer
roles.job: Writes the final report and the structured data.

roles.name: reviewer
roles.job: Checks each claim and number in the report against the raw evidence.

steps.do: Give one evidence source to each investigator. Each one writes facts with timestamps and example lines.
Make one timeline. List all possible causes. For each one, write the evidence for and against it.
Write the deliverables from the analysis.
Check each number and time against the raw data. Send errors back to the writer.

rules: Calculate numbers from the raw data with a script. Do not guess them.
Each claim in the report must point to evidence.
